resolution_register.resolution: EXECUTE_BOUND_RUN is the sole execution-entry operation. ADVANCE_SCIENTIFIC_STATE is absent.

resolution_register.safety: Run identity remains outside execution-semantics content while exact run authorization still binds it.

resolution_register.resolution: T2FixtureCapability is absent and deferred to I-6. ScientificExecutionLease is absent and deferred to I-5. CapabilityClass and AccessCapability are the only I-4 capability types. No T2/T3 constructor or factory exists.

trust_mechanics.profile: exact three issuer roots with threshold two; exact three revocation roots with threshold two; exact three online time keys with one signature; installed ObjectRef and hash pin is out of band
trust_mechanics.root_proofs: exactly two, distinct signer key IDs, ECJ-1 key-ID order, no surplus proof, each role matches threshold
trust_mechanics.issuer_registry: genesis sequence is 0 with GENESIS predecessor; later sequence is exactly prior+1 and predecessor is prior ref; equal sequence requires byte-identical ref; lower is rollback; greater than prior+1 is gap; unequal same-sequence ref is equivocation; current time is within [valid_from,next_update)
trust_mechanics.delegation: ordered leaf-to-root tuple of zero through four credentials; each proof corresponds positionally; exact issuer/key continuity; no repeated credential ref or issuer/key pair; no cycle; common trust and revocation authority; intersection-only scope; child is subset of parent in stage, operation, namespace, kind, time, and exclusions; remaining depth decreases by exactly one; scope union and multiple parents are forbidden
trust_mechanics.trusted_time: production creates exactly 32 random bytes with secrets.token_bytes(32), canonical base64url encodes them, makes exactly one synchronous service call, accepts no caller-supplied or cached response, requires exact request binding, signer pin, strictly increasing durable service sequence, issued_at <= attested_utc < expires_at, expires_at-issued_at <=30 seconds, and local monotonic elapsed <=30 seconds
trust_mechanics.synthetic_time: only a nonproduction validation profile may inject the exact challenge and monotonic values frozen by the validation contract; the production entry has no injection parameter
trust_mechanics.revocation: exactly one service call returns current snapshot and exactly two ordered root proofs; genesis and continuity rules mirror issuer registry; lifetime <=300 seconds; attested time is in [as_of,next_update); entries ordered by (entry_kind,revoked_ref,effective_utc,reason), duplicate (entry_kind,revoked_ref) rejected; each issuer, key, delegation, authorization, and trust-profile successor is checked
trust_mechanics.state_persistence: verified issuer, revocation, and time sequences are durably persisted before any later check or use; persistence uncertainty fails closed

acceptance_mechanics.common: Every mutation requires a durably matching AuthorizationUseRecord resolved from the configured store; a constructed but absent record has no authority. Consumption precedes mutation and is permanent even if the later mutation fails.
acceptance_mechanics.registry_acceptance: Candidate is DRAFT or REVIEWED, exact content/hash already passes its owner validator, operation/target/lifecycle match, no conflict exists; append a new immutable ACCEPTED registry state without changing candidate content.
acceptance_mechanics.registry_supersession: Predecessor is ACCEPTED, successor is DRAFT or REVIEWED, accepted I-2 SupersessionRelation validator passes, relation refs match, version increases and content changes; one atomic registry transaction appends predecessor SUPERSEDED and successor ACCEPTED states.
acceptance_mechanics.configuration_acceptance: validate_experiment_configuration passes on the exact candidate and supplied fault-schedule witness; authorization targets exact draft ref; append ACCEPTED without changing configuration content.
acceptance_mechanics.binding_acceptance: validate_execution_binding passes; referenced configuration is already ACCEPTED and exact; accepted_configuration_ref matches; append ACCEPTED without changing binding content.
acceptance_mechanics.operational_ledger: validate_ledger passes before append; LedgerKind is OPERATIONAL; predecessor, ordinal, and head are exact; append entry and new head atomically. Scientific-ledger append remains I-5.
acceptance_mechanics.synthetic: Validation profiles may perform the same transitions only in a temporary store and reserved ebu:*:validation:* namespaces. Cleanup removes only the validated temporary directory after all handles close.
acceptance_mechanics.production: Until an exact governance bootstrap instance passes its schema and is operator-pinned, all five I-4 mutation callables fail PRODUCTION_BOOTSTRAP_MISSING before service, SQLite, registry, or ledger mutation.

sqlite_contract.path: explicit absolute normalized path; existing real parent; basename authorization-use-v1.sqlite3; neither parent nor file is a symlink; no environment-variable/default/current-directory fallback

CREATE TABLE authorization_use(use_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,authorization_ref_ecj1 BLOB NOT NULL,requested_operation TEXT NOT NULL,target_refs_ecj1 BLOB NOT NULL,configuration_ref_ecj1 BLOB NOT NULL,binding_ref_ecj1 BLOB NOT NULL,execution_identity_ecj1 BLOB NOT NULL,consumed_utc TEXT NOT NULL,validation_record_ecj1 BLOB NOT NULL,ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='CONSUMED'),FOREIGN KEY(ledger_entry_id) REFERENCES operational_ledger(entry_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED) STRICT;

sqlite_contract.duplicate: On primary-key conflict issue ROLLBACK; one read-only exact-key lookup may classify ALREADY_CONSUMED only when the stored coupled rows validate exactly; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
sqlite_contract.lock_and_io: SQLITE_BUSY, SQLITE_LOCKED, I/O, FULL, CORRUPT, NOTADB, CANTOPEN, schema drift, setting drift, fsync/durability uncertainty, and unexpected exceptions normalize to AUTHORIZATION_USE_UNRESOLVED; no protected operation enters.
sqlite_contract.ambiguous_commit: After COMMIT is issued and an error/connection loss occurs, perform at most one new-connection read-only recheck. Exact use plus exact coupled ledger row returns CONSUMED; missing, partial, mismatching, or unreadable state returns UNRESOLVED. Never repeat INSERT.
sqlite_contract.permanence: No API, DDL, cleanup, expiry, correction, revocation, or administrative action deletes, resets, or reuses a consumed use key.
sqlite_contract.distributed_claim: No distributed, replicated, network-filesystem, multi-site, or cross-database single-use claim is made.
sqlite_contract.synthetic_cleanup: Create with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory on a qualified local filesystem; close all connections; verify realpath containment; remove only database, -journal, -wal, and -shm if present; then remove that directory. Production cleanup is forbidden.
